en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a broad market square lined with multi‑story historic townhouses. The buildings have steep gabled roofs and ornate façades with shops at street level. A tall decorative streetlamp stands near the center foreground. Small groups of people gather in front of the buildings. Printed in red at the top left is the caption identifying the location as the old market. Additional German shop signs are visible on the right‑hand buildings.
